notes:
v4.6.94 — Onboarding, broker logos, per-broker summary, chart fix, separate Manual workspace

👋 FIRST-RUN GUIDE
• A one-time Welcome wizard now greets new accounts: intro → pick your broker → step-by-step on how to create & link an Alpaca or IBKR account → done.

📘 CONNECT INSTRUCTIONS
• Tools → Alpaca and Tools → IBKR each gained a collapsible “How to create & link a … account” guide (also shown in Manual mode), with a one-click link to the broker’s site.

🏷️ BROKER LOGOS
• Bot cards now show the Alpaca / IBKR logos instead of small text chips.

📊 PER-BROKER SUMMARY
• A headline card at the top of the Overview combines EVERY bot on the active broker: total value, day P/L, total P/L and open positions — with the broker’s logo.

📈 PORTFOLIO CHART FIX
• The portfolio-value graph was flat: IBKR/custom bots record equity only (no P/L), so the line plotted zeros. It now derives P/L from equity and includes ALL bots (e.g. your energy bot), so the curve matches the live total.

✋ MANUAL = ITS OWN WORKSPACE
• Switching to Manual now hides every auto-mode tab and nav button — only the broker chip stays shared. The Manual page is self-contained (connect keys + instructions inline), the blank-metrics bug is fixed, and it works on its dedicated Alpaca paper account even while the app is set to IBKR.

Update via the in-app banner.
